text: I must admit I lied a little when suggesting Effect.gen was morally equivalent to async/await. It's actually much better. Consider the sleep-deprived user who enters "banana" instead of her age. Perhaps we should fail with a BadNumber error. The moment this is added to askAge 's type, it changes the type of getUser. Likewise, if askName starts getting picky, its error automatically propagates to the outer type, forming a union of all possible errors. We now have three execution paths. askName could fail, causing getUser to fail. Or it could succeed, only for askAge to fail, short-circuiting once more. Or everything succeeds, hooray.
